caption: Figure 7. Storing the KV cache of two requests at the same time in vLLM.
description:
This figure illustrates the memory management strategy for storing the key-value (KV) cache of two concurrent requests in a large language model (LLM) serving system, as described in the paper "Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention." It shows how physical KV blocks are mapped to logical KV blocks for two requests, A and B, to optimize memory usage.

The figure displays two sets of logical KV blocks for Request A and Request B, each containing words like "Four," "score," "and," "seven," "years," "ago," "our," "fathers," "brought," "of," "times," "It," "was," "the," and "best." These blocks are stored in physical KV blocks, with Request A's blocks on the left and Request B's blocks on the right. The mapping between logical and physical blocks is shown, indicating how the system efficiently utilizes memory to handle multiple requests simultaneously.
